notes.title: Cheat Codes & Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Cheat Codes that can be activated in the game. Works as follows;
Each action resets after 3 seconds of inactivity. 
ShrinkAndSteal = T
Jump = M
Sprint = R

Cheat codes 

 TTMMRM
 MMMRM
 TMTMTM
 TTTTMMM
 TTTTTTM

Try them and see what happens. Cheat codes can be applied more than once.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44360775/790435083651cc3d85d3a2143fe54dad140ddcd2.png

You can see what icon to press to pick up items now & the training map has been moved high in the main menu.
